title: Cold & Flu Recovery Curve
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=symptom:log episode=*
| stats min(_time) as onset, max(_time) as recovered, max(severity) as peak by episode
| eval duration_days=round((recovered-onset)/86400,1)
| sort - onset
description: Records how long each cold or illness lasted and how bad it got, building your personal recovery history.
value: Knowing your typical recovery time sets expectations and flags when an illness is dragging on unusually long.
implementation: Group symptom episodes in `index=personal`; review duration and peak severity per illness.
visualization: Table of illness episodes with duration and peak severity.
grandmaExplanation: It records how long each cold lasts and how bad it got, so you know what is normal for you.
